panels.description: Mera places the lever on the civic table; adjacent records unlock for debt, travel, water and House review. Keep the lever dominant and reserve upper space.
Alex's debt record previews clearance available. Keep the record clear for lettering.
Ada catches Alex's wrist before he reaches for the lever. Keep their hands and the lever visible; leave upper space.
Alex looks between Lina's unsigned form, Tomas's verified reading and the lever. The affected residents remain behind him; no recognizable crowd. Leave upper space.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: If you hold all the keys, everyone waits for your hand.
